modules.module_title: Prepare for the propagation of bamboo sapling in the nursery

pcs.pc_description: select a site for the propagation of bamboo saplings in the nursery, ensuring proximity to the bamboo field with the recommended climatic conditions, adequate exposure to sunlight and access to quality water in the required quantity

modules.module_title: Prepare the field for bamboo cultivation

pcs.pc_description: remove all waste materials from the site

sample the field soil and coordinate with an approved lab to determine its macro and micronutrients needs
apply the prescribed organic and inorganic fertilisers such as compost, peat moss or Farm Yard Manure (FYM) to the soil in the dose recommended by the lab to improve its fertility and loosen it

create drains in the field for the effective drainage of water
install an appropriate irrigation or fertigation system in the field
erect fences around the field to protect it from stray animals and other external threats
